name: Silent's Cel Shading Shader
description: Unity shaders for cel/toon shading. Designed to take Unity's HDR lighting into account while presenting materials in the best possible way.
author: Silent

name: Watari (Converter for Basis)
description: Converts VRChat, VRM and Dynamic Bone components on an avatar into their Basis equivalents: jiggle physics, constraints, the avatar descriptor, HVR Vixxy controls and authored motion.
author: yuna0x0

name: Basis Steam Transport
description: Steam network transport for Basis. Adds the 'steam' network stack: players connect to a host's or a dedicated server's Steam ID (steam:<SteamID64>) over the Steam relay, with no port forwarding and no exposed IP address. Unity on Windows, Linux and macOS, and the Basis Server through the Basis Package Manager.
author: dooly123

name: Basis Steam Lobby
description: Steam lobbies for Basis, on top of the Basis Steam Transport package. Adds a Steam Lobbies menu panel: host a session and open a Steam lobby for it, browse friends' and public lobbies, invite friends, and join over the Steam relay with no port forwarding. Desktop only (Windows, Linux, macOS).
author: dooly123

name: Basis WebSocket Transport
description: WebSocket network transport for Basis. Web builds connect through it, and native clients can use it on networks that block UDP. Adds the 'websocket' network stack to the client and, through the Basis Server package manager, to the server.
author: dooly123

name: VR Stage Lighting URP
description: Standalone Unity 6 / URP 17+ realtime lighting and raymarched volumetric beams driven from DMX or AudioLink data. Render-pass injection at runtime, no URP Renderer Feature changes, no project-side renderer settings touched. Co-installable with com.acchosen.vr-stage-lighting (asset GUIDs, shader names, and runtime globals are namespaced to avoid collision); existing upstream scenes continue to work alongside.
author: towneh

name: Toys LAN Discovery
description: Finds Basis servers on your local network. Servers on the same LAN appear in the Servers panel by themselves, with no address to type, and a hosted session can be shown to the LAN from the host settings. Uses mDNS/DNS-SD. Install it into the Unity project to browse and announce, and into a Basis Server through the Basis Package Manager to announce dedicated servers.
author: Toys0125
